units.source_text: 这次旅行的细节，我至今记忆犹新。

en.t: I still remember the details of this journey vividly.

units.source_text: 我的出走，并不是没有目的地。

en.t: My flight from home was not without a destination.

units.source_text: 我的目的地就是中学时代一度修学旅行过的地方。

en.t: My destination was the place I had once visited on a school trip in middle school.

units.source_text: 但是，渐渐接近了这地方的时候，由于出发和解放的思绪过分强烈，我感到我前方仿佛只有一个未知的领域。

en.t: But as I gradually approached that place, my feelings of departure and liberation were so intense that it seemed to me there was only an unknown realm ahead.
